summary: The AI video generation landscape in 2026 is dominated by Google's Veo 3.1, which commands an overwhelming share of measured video generations thanks to native audio, vertical formats, and longer clips. With OpenAI's Sora discontinued (API ending September 24, 2026), the competitive field has shifted toward specialists: Kling leads on price-to-quality, Runway on editing depth, Luma on image-to-video, and avatar-focused tools like Synthesia and HeyGen dominate enterprise training and marketing. Most teams use multiple models depending on the specific use case.

tools.name: Veo (Veo 3.1)
tools.pricing_paid: Available via Google AI Pro/Ultra plans and Gemini (approx. $19.99-$249.99/month); also via Vertex AI API usage-based pricing
strengths: Dominant market share (~96% of measured generations)
Integrated into Google Flow filmmaking tool
tools.best_for: High-quality cinematic video with synchronized native audio

tools.name: Kling AI (Kling 3.0)
tools.pricing_paid: Paid plans from approx. $6.99/month; strong free tier with 166 daily credits
strengths: Best free tier with no watermark on standard outputs
tools.best_for: Realistic motion and affordable high-quality video generation

tools.name: Runway (Gen-4.5)
tools.pricing_paid: Paid plans from approx. $15/month (Standard) up to Enterprise
strengths: Green-screen replacement, motion brushes, frame interpolation, lip-sync
tools.best_for: Filmmakers and motion designers needing deep editing and creative control

tools.name: Synthesia
tools.pricing_paid: Starter from approx. $18/month; Creator and Enterprise tiers
tools.max_length: Varies by plan (minutes of video per month)
tools.best_for: Corporate training, L&D, and enterprise marketing avatar videos

tools.name: HeyGen
tools.max_length: Up to ~30 minutes depending on plan
tools.best_for: AI avatars for marketing, sales, and localized video content

tools.name: Luma Dream Machine (Ray 3)
tools.best_for: Image-to-video and cinematic storytelling with consistent visuals

tools.name: Pika
tools.best_for: Fast, trendy short-form social video effects

tools.name: Opus Clip
tools.max_length: Processes long recordings into short clips
strengths: Turns long videos into short captioned clips
tools.best_for: Repurposing long recordings into viral short-form clips

tools.name: Descript
tools.best_for: Editing and clipping recordings via a text-based workflow

tools.name: Captions
tools.best_for: Creating captioned talking-head and social short-form video

tools.name: ElevenLabs
tools.pricing_paid: Paid plans from approx. $5/month (voice); video access via unified tiers
strengths: Access to leading video models through one interface
tools.best_for: Combining best-in-class AI voice with video generation in one interface
